sources.currentValues: Subvertadown 2026 unadjusted half-PPR BEER+ draft board

dynastyRanking.scoringFormat: Not identified in the source dataset; this is not labeled half-PPR.
dynastyRanking.matching: Unique normalized player name plus position; FantasyPros ID retained for Sleeper crosswalk.

keeperComparison.method: Direct FantasyPros consensus dynasty ECR compared with the possible pick costs in each keeper round. No forecast, simulation, probability, or multi-year weighting is used.
keeperComparison.rankEdgeFormula: cost pick minus dynasty ECR; positive means the player is ranked earlier than the cost
keeperComparison.eligibility: A player is eligible only if actually drafted after Round 2; every board player is scored because draft-day falls determine eligibility.
keeperComparison.caveat: Dynasty ECR values youth and long careers more than this league's two-season keeper window, so older productive players may look conservative.
